examples.fr: Si j'avais su, je serais venu plus tôt.
examples.en: If I had known, I would have come earlier.

examples.fr: Si j'avais su, je ne serais pas parti.
examples.en: If I had known, I wouldn't have left.
I should have called you earlier.
I should have listened to your advice.

examples.fr: Je regrette de ne pas être venu.
Peut-être que nous avons eu tort.
À supposer que tu aies raison, que faire ?
examples.en: Supposing you're right, what should we do?

examples.fr: À supposer qu'il refuse, nous chercherons ailleurs.
examples.en: Supposing he refuses, we'll look elsewhere.

examples.fr: On pourrait éventuellement reporter la réunion.
examples.en: We could possibly postpone the meeting.

examples.fr: Éventuellement, je viendrai avec un ami.
examples.en: If need be, I'll come with a friend.

examples.fr: J'ai raté mon train ce matin.
examples.en: I missed my train this morning.

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.text: Tu as raté ton train hier soir, c'est vrai ?
dialogue.en: You missed your train last night, is that right?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Oui. J'aurais dû partir plus tôt, je le regrette.
dialogue.en: Yes. I should have left earlier, I regret it.

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.text: Si j'avais su, je serais venu te chercher en voiture.
dialogue.en: If I had known, I would have come to pick you up by car.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: C'est gentil. Peut-être que la prochaine fois, je t'appellerai.
dialogue.en: That's kind. Maybe next time I'll call you.

dialogue.speaker: Paul
dialogue.text: À supposer que ça se reproduise, tu pourras éventuellement dormir chez moi.
dialogue.en: Supposing it happens again, you could possibly sleep at my place.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Merci. Si j'avais su que tu étais si généreux, je t'aurais appelé !
dialogue.en: Thanks. If I had known you were so generous, I would have called you!

practice_words.tip: Careful: it means 'possibly', not 'eventually'. Say é-van-tuèl-MAN
